title: For Europe's far right 'there's no way to win voters while they're trying to appease Trump'
summary: Speaking with FRANCE 24's Sharon Gaffney, Georgios Samaras, Assistant Professor of Public Policy at the School for Government at King’s College London, says that Donald Trump is deeply unpopular among the general population across Europe and that for far right parties in Europe 'there's no way to win voters while they're trying to appease Trump'.
